faq_heading: Homes near Henry Bose Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Henry Bose Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Henry Bose Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Henry Bose Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Henry Bose Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 73 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,138,500, townhomes $694,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Henry Bose Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Henry Bose Elementary the median was 25 days on the market, closing at 96.3% of the list price, with 11% of sales above the list price for the 73 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Henry Bose Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (0.4 km south-west), St Bernadette (0.6 km west) and North Ridge Elementary (0.7 km south).

Henry Bose Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 6550 134 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Henry Bose Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Henry Bose Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Henry Bose Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Henry Bose Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 73 homes sold within 1 km of Henry Bose Elementary: 42 houses, 26 townhomes and 1 condo. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,138,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Henry Bose Elementary

29 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Henry Bose Elementary in a straight line (21 elementary, 6 secondary, 2 other; 6 independent). The closest is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Frank Hurt Secondary, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is St Bernadette (0.6 km); the nearest independent school is St Bernadette (0.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: St Bernadette (0.6 km west), North Ridge Elementary (0.7 km south), Martha Jane Norris Elementary (1.0 km west), W E Kinvig Elementary (1.1 km north), Hyland Elementary (1.2 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is St Bernadette, 0.6 km west of Henry Bose Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Henry Bose Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Henry Bose Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Henry Bose Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Henry Bose Elementary was $1,138,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at St Bernadette, the nearest other elementary school, 0.6 km west of Henry Bose Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
